svg.title: Schelling segregation simulation snapshots
svg.desc: Three snapshots of a Schelling segregation simulation on a 20 by 20 grid with threshold tau = 3/8. The initial random mix of two agent types becomes increasingly clustered after a few rounds of unsatisfied agents relocating, and reaches a sharply segregated stable state in which no agent wants to move.
svg.text: Schelling simulation — mild preferences (τ = 3/8), sharp global segregation
